Container.Name: Rube

Branch.TagDescription: Built from master — unreleased, may break

Container.Overview:
A self-hosted Plex companion for automating library curation. Define rules over your Plex media (using metadata from IMDb/OMDb and requests from Overseerr) to drive collections, overlays, prerolls, labels and notifications on a schedule.
Features: [b]Rules engine[/b] — rules that produce Plex collections from your library, refreshed on a schedule with full run history. [b]Smart filters[/b] — compose criteria over Plex metadata, IMDb ratings and Overseerr requests; AI-assisted filter generation. [b]Collections[/b] — auto-managed Plex collections with sort order, pinning and shuffle hubs. [b]Overlays[/b] — stamp ratings, badges and labels onto poster artwork. [b]Personalized home screens[/b] — per-user recommendations, with a self-service portal where each user tunes their own tastes. [b]Prerolls[/b] — upload the videos Plex plays before a movie; anything Plex would not direct play is transcoded automatically. [b]Notifications[/b] — Discord, Slack, Telegram, Gotify, Pushbullet, Pushover, LunaSea and generic webhooks.
[b]IMPORTANT — Rube's admin UI is unauthenticated.[/b] Anyone who can reach the WebUI port can change every setting. Keep port 3000 on your LAN or behind an authenticating reverse proxy; never forward it to the internet. The separate [b]User Portal[/b] port (3100) is the one designed to be exposed — it requires Sign in with Plex.
[b]Prerolls path mapping.[/b] Plex stores prerolls as paths on [i]its own[/i] filesystem, so Rube and Plex must share a directory. Map the same host share into both containers, then set Settings → Prerolls → "The same directory, as Plex sees it" to whatever path the Plex container mounts it at. If both use /prerolls, the default is already correct. Prerolls are a Plex Pass feature.

Config.Name: WebUI Port (admin)
Config.Description: The admin UI and API. UNAUTHENTICATED — keep this on your LAN, behind a firewall or an authenticating reverse proxy. Do not port-forward it.

Config.Name: User Portal Port
Config.Description: The self-service 'Sign in with Plex' portal where users set their own recommendation preferences. Safe to expose publicly. Only listens while Personalized Home Screens is enabled in Settings.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent state: the SQLite database, settings and cached artwork. Back this up.

Config.Name: Prerolls
Config.Description: Videos Plex plays before a movie. Only needed for the Prerolls feature. Map this SAME host path into your Plex container (read access is enough there), then tell Rube the Plex-side path under Settings → Prerolls.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files in /config and /prerolls. Unraid's default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files in /config and /prerolls. Unraid's default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used to evaluate cron schedules, so '3am' stays 3am across daylight-saving changes. Can also be set in Jobs → Schedule, which takes precedence.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: debug | info | warn | error. Raise to debug to see per-job detail in the container log.

Config.Name: LOG_FORMAT
Config.Description: Set to 'json' for one JSON object per line, if you ship container logs to a collector. Leave empty for human-readable output.
